source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#1 Many performances should resize and page; morning/afternoon/evening filter
what: More than 8 times show as compact tiles, paged 24 at a time with Earlier/Later, plus day-part chips with counts. Config: Times per page (8/12/24/all, default 24), Morning/afternoon/evening filter (on/off).
package: listPerformances (catalogue.yaml ~l.2150) pages by from/to with PageSize/PageCursor, so paging works. Missing: no day-part concept; BookingFlowConfig has no timesPerPage or dayPartFilter. getAvailability (catalogue.yaml ~l.3031) takes one performanceId (or channelCapacityId) and has no eventId/date filter, so 64 tiles with remaining counts means 64 calls; its response is also inline (already a WEB-006 gap).
proposal: Add BookingFlowConfig.timesPerPage enum [8,12,24,all] default 24 and dayPartFilter bool default true. Fix the day-part boundaries in the venue time zone on WEB-006/GST-007 (morning before 12:00, afternoon 12:00-17:00, evening from 17:00). Add eventId + from/to query params to getAvailability and name its response schema.
needsClient: Confirm the day-part boundaries (proposed: before 12:00, 12:00-17:00, from 17:00).
decision: Add BookingFlowConfig.timesPerPage enum [8,12,24,all] default 24 and dayPartFilter bool default true. Fix the day-part boundaries in the venue time zone on WEB-006/GST-007 (morning before 12:00, afternoon 12:00-17:00, evening from 17:00). Add eventId + from/to query params to getAvailability and name its response schema. Day-part boundaries are venue settings, default before 12:00 / 12:00-17:00 / from 17:00.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#2 Step 1 date, step 2 time only after date, step 3 ticket only after date and time
what: Time sits right after the date and stays hidden until a date is picked; tickets stay hidden until a time is picked; Continue stays off until both are chosen. Config: Performance reveal = Date->time->ticket (default) or All at once.
package: Package navigation runs the other way: WEB-006 Date & Performance Selection has entryFrom WEB-005 Ticket Type Selection (flow F01: ticket type, then date). GST-007 Select Date & Time comes before GST-008 on mobile. BookingFlowConfig has no reveal setting.
proposal: Reorder the dated flow to WEB-006 (date, then time) before WEB-005 (tickets), or fold both into one staged step, and state the reveal rule on the screens. Add BookingFlowConfig.performanceReveal enum [dateTimeTicket, allAtOnce] default dateTimeTicket.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Reorder the dated flow to WEB-006 (date, then time) before WEB-005 (tickets), or fold both into one staged step, and state the reveal rule on the screens. Add BookingFlowConfig.performanceReveal enum [dateTimeTicket, allAtOnce] default dateTimeTicket.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#3 Sign-in screen after Add-ons
what: Sign-in (or guest code when guest checkout is on) is asked when the guest leaves Add-ons; basket kept. Config: Ask to sign in = After add-ons (default) or At payment.
package: Compatible with the package rule: FeatureToggle guestCheckout (white-label.yaml ~l.3712) 'gates checkout, never the cart', and identity.yaml ~l.144 routes at checkout. Checkout entry is GST-041 on mobile; on web the gate sits at WEB-012. No setting chooses where the gate appears.
proposal: Add BookingFlowConfig.signInAt enum [afterAddOns, atPayment] default afterAddOns. On web, move the gate from WEB-012 to the WEB-008 exit when afterAddOns.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add BookingFlowConfig.signInAt enum [afterAddOns, atPayment] default afterAddOns. On web, move the gate from WEB-012 to the WEB-008 exit when afterAddOns.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#4 Flow 1 (fixed date and time) and Flow 2 (date, then time, then seat map); pop-up or inline option
what: Seated events either go straight to the seat map (single performance) or ask date and time first, inline or as a pop-up over the seat map. Config: Date & time on seat events = Inline step or Pop-up on the seat map.
package: Both flows exist: WEB-006 -> WEB-007 carries performanceId (flow F02), and a single-performance event can skip WEB-006. GST-007 -> GST-049 on mobile. No setting chooses inline vs pop-up.
proposal: Add BookingFlowConfig.seatEventDateMode enum [inlineStep, popupOnSeatMap] default inlineStep. Add a date/time overlay to WEB-007 and GST-049 for the pop-up mode. Skip WEB-006 when the event has exactly one on-sale performance.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add BookingFlowConfig.seatEventDateMode enum [inlineStep, popupOnSeatMap] default inlineStep. Add a date/time overlay to WEB-007 and GST-049 for the pop-up mode. Skip WEB-006 when the event has exactly one on-sale performance.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#5 CMS option: seat view box right, left, top or bottom
what: Position of the 'view from your seat' box around the seat map; drops below on narrow screens. Config: Seat view box = Bottom/Right/Left/Top.
package: BookingFlowConfig has no field for it. The view itself has no data source (see 23SEP-14).
proposal: Add BookingFlowConfig.seatViewPosition enum [bottom, right, left, top] default bottom (web only; mobile always below).
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add BookingFlowConfig.seatViewPosition enum [bottom, right, left, top] default bottom (web only; mobile always below).

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#6 Time selection on top, configurable (time bar above the seat map)
what: Time sits under the date on the selection step. On the seat map a time bar shows the chosen performance, lets the guest switch show and has Change date; changing the show releases held seats. Config: Time bar above seat map (on/off).
package: relinquishSeatHold and createSeatHold exist (seating.yaml ~l.1260, ~l.1161). WEB-007/GST-049 declare no performance switcher, and BookingFlowConfig has no toggle.
proposal: Add a performance switcher region to WEB-007/GST-049: listPerformances for the event; on a change, relinquishSeatHold and then a new hold. Add BookingFlowConfig.seatTimeBar bool default true.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add a performance switcher region to WEB-007/GST-049: listPerformances for the event; on a change, relinquishSeatHold and then a new hold. Add BookingFlowConfig.seatTimeBar bool default true.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#7 Theatre flow like the stadium, with its own auditorium seat map; show and seats on one step; up to ten seats
what: Grand Playhouse has a stage/screen, Stalls/Circle/Balcony with curved rows, aisles and 3 price bands. Date, time, show (plus language & format for cinema) and the seat map sit on one page. Max 10 seats per booking; basket lists each seat.
package: Seat maps are layout-agnostic: createSeatMap/importSeatGeometry, seat categories and non-sellable zones such as a stage (seating.yaml ~l.3258). The package splits the step over two screens (WEB-006, WEB-007). CreateSeatHoldRequest allows up to 50 seats. R080(c) set 10 per sale for POS only; no guest seat limit exists. Language/format has no field (see REV3-17).
proposal: Allow WEB-006+WEB-007 (and GST-007+GST-049) to render as one step for seated events. Add VenueSettings.seating.maxSeatsPerGuestOrder (default 10, bounds 1-50) to the configured-limits sheet, applied by createSeatHold on guest channels.
needsClient: Confirm 10 seats as the guest-channel maximum per booking.
decision: Seats per guest booking is a venue setting, default 10 (bounds 1-50). Allow WEB-006+WEB-007 (and GST-007+GST-049) to render as one step for seated events. Add VenueSettings.seating.maxSeatsPerGuestOrder (default 10, bounds 1-50) to the configured-limits sheet, applied by createSeatHold on guest channels.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#8 Unable to complete the table booking flow
what: Prototype bug: a table reservation had nothing priced in the basket. Now adds 'Table for 4 . 19:30 . no card needed' to the basket and completes. Waitlist is fixed the same way.
package: In the package a table reservation never enters the cart: WEB-036/GST-070 call createTableReservation directly (fnb.yaml ~l.3545), which takes no payment (R077(a)). Waitlist is joinRestaurantWaitlist/leaveRestaurantWaitlist (R073(d)). A zero-price 'table' cart line has no cart-line kind.
proposal: No contract change. Keep the table reservation and waitlist out of the cart: confirm straight after createTableReservation with a 'no card needed' confirmation. Tell the client the basket line is prototype-only.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): No contract change. Keep the table reservation and waitlist out of the cart: confirm straight after createTableReservation with a 'no card needed' confirmation. Tell the client the basket line is prototype-only.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#8 deposit hold flow ('the deposit hold adds AED 100 per guest')
what: A dining 'deposit hold' flow charges AED 100 per guest.
package: Contradicts audit R077(a), 'No deposit and no no-show fee in the first release', applied in fnb.yaml createTableReservation (~l.3560) and the GST-070 notes. DepositPolicy (orders.yaml ~l.10896) lists 'dining' in appliesTo for later.
proposal: Hide the deposit-hold flow for the first release. If the client wants it, a CR reopens R077(a) and uses DepositPolicy (basis fixedPerGuest, appliesTo dining).
needsClient: The deposit hold contradicts the 28 Sep default (R077(a), no table deposit in the first release). Remove it from the prototype, or raise a CR?
decision: Keep the deposit hold as a venue option, off unless the venue enables it in Venue Management; the amount and basis (per guest, per table, percentage...) are venue configuration, never a hard-coded AED 100. Supersedes R077(a) 'no table deposit in the first release': the capability ships, disabled by default.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#9 Add-ons and modifiers for F&B menu items
what: In the takeaway, delivery and café menus, Add opens a side panel with choose-one options, priced optional add-ons and quantity; the basket line lists the choices. Config: F&B add-ons & modifiers (on/off).
package: Exists: ModifierGroup, listModifierGroups (guest-readable), attachModifierGroup (fnb.yaml ~l.1128, ~l.4872). WEB-036, WEB-037 and GST-024 already declare listModifierGroups. A per-tenant on/off is redundant: an item shows modifiers when groups are attached.
proposal: Draw the modifier side panel on WEB-037/GST-061 (no api change). Drop the Config toggle: modifiers show when the item has attached groups.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Draw the modifier side panel on WEB-037/GST-061 (no api change). Drop the Config toggle: modifiers show when the item has attached groups.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#10 Cart display: fixed right, left, slide-in, slide-up, floating icon, single column; right for Arabic (+ Update 28 Sep: stays right in Arabic)
what: Config Cart & summary adds 'Floating cart icon' (round basket button with count). New Cart side in Arabic = Keep on right (default) or Mirror to left. The client confirmed the basket stays on the right in Arabic.
package: BookingFlowConfig.cartLayout enum = sidebarRight, sidebarLeft, slideInRight, slideUpBottom, singleColumn. It lacks floatingIcon, and no field controls the cart side under RTL.
proposal: Add 'floatingIcon' to BookingFlowConfig.cartLayout. Add cartSideInRtl enum [keepRight, mirror] default keepRight.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add 'floatingIcon' to BookingFlowConfig.cartLayout. Add cartSideInRtl enum [keepRight, mirror] default keepRight.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#11 Help me choose; CLIENT-RESPONSE-FEEDBACK-23SEP.md#20 Build your experience in the CMS; BUILD-YOUR-EXPERIENCE.md; also 28 Sep 'Help me choose banner'
what: A 1-2 question quiz (3 answers each, with title, one-liner, icon and optional badge) maps the last answer to a booking flow/product with a result card. Shown as a button, a pop-up on arrival, or off, and now as a dark banner under the products. Runs on Kids Club, Coastal Aqua and Tidewater Museum.
package: Nothing in the contracts: no quiz, question, answer or 'guided choice' entity, and no BookingFlowConfig field. White-label LinkTarget (kind product/event, white-label.yaml ~l.3165) can already express 'answer -> product'. Not found in sources/ (no match for quiz, questionnaire, help me choose or guided selling).
proposal: Add a venue-scoped GuidedChoice config to white-label (part of the published tenant config): mode enum [button, popupOnArrival, banner, off]; questions[<=2] {text: LocalisedText, answers[3] {title, description, iconKey, badge, target: LinkTarget}}; resultCards keyed by target {title, description, imageAssetId}. Guests read it through the public tenant config. Add get/setGuidedChoice (TENANT_CONFIGURE).
needsClient: Help me choose is not in the RFP sources. Accept it as in scope (CR), or keep it as a later option?
decision: Help me choose is in scope as a venue configuration (questions, answers, the flow each answer opens). Once products are uploaded, AI analyses them and proposes Help me choose sections, which the venue reviews and publishes (a suggestion, never auto-published).

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#13 House of Wisdom: meeting room by the hour
what: Date -> start time -> length (1h, 2h, half day, full day) -> room type (focus pod, majlis, boardroom, auditorium) -> attendees -> add-ons (coffee break, lunch, AV technician). Price = room rate x length.
package: Partly grounded. The 26 Aug minute says a guest books 'a meeting room product', never a raw room (resources.yaml bookResource, ~l.230). ResourceKind has room/auditorium; ResourcePackage 'Conference Package' (~l.1385); setExperienceResourceRequirements + allocateResources; getResourceAvailability is guest-callable. Missing: AddCartLineRequest (orders.yaml ~l.13196) carries performanceId but no free start/end window, so a guest cannot buy 'room type X, 14:00, 2 hours'. No length-based pricing and no guest screen. Sources: Meeting Room appears only as a group-package component (workshop pack Group Sales 9.1.5) and in the 26 Aug minute.
proposal: Model each room type as a product with VariantDimension 'length' (1h, 2h, half, full), priced per variant. Add AddCartLineRequest.window {startsAt, endsAt} for resource-backed products; getResourceAvailability supplies start times; allocateResources picks the room at checkout. Add a staged 'Book a space' flow to WEB-005/WEB-006 (or a new WEB/GST screen).
needsClient: Is online self-booking of meeting rooms by the hour in scope for the first release? It is not a guest screen in the plan.
decision: Meeting rooms by the hour are in scope (our proposal: products with a length dimension and a booked time window on the cart line).

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#14 Ticket category shown with details but booking off (info-only products)
what: A product can be marked information only: it keeps details and photo, shows an 'Info only / Not bookable online' label and opens details instead of adding to the basket. Config: Show info-only products (on/off).
package: Product (catalogue.yaml ~l.11565) has channels[] and derived isSellable but no 'visible but not bookable' flag. searchCatalogue is explicitly 'scoped to what is on sale ... so a guest never finds a product they cannot buy' (~l.921), so today an info-only product would simply be hidden.
proposal: Add Product.guestListing enum [bookable, infoOnly, hidden] default bookable, plus an optional notBookableLabel (LocalisedText). listProducts/searchCatalogue return infoOnly products flagged, and addCartLine refuses them (409). Amend the searchCatalogue description. Add BookingFlowConfig.showInfoOnly bool default true.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add Product.guestListing enum [bookable, infoOnly, hidden] default bookable, plus an optional notBookableLabel (LocalisedText). listProducts/searchCatalogue return infoOnly products flagged, and addCartLine refuses them (409). Amend the searchCatalogue description. Add BookingFlowConfig.showInfoOnly bool default true.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#15 Book the product from the map (cabana); 28 Sep 'Book a cabana from the map'; EMAIL-TO-CLIENT.md ask 2
what: The Coastal Aqua cabana map on the first screen: 34 numbered cabanas (R01-R10, T01-T08, S01-S06, B01-B10) with seat counts, sold-out greyed. Tapping one adds e.g. 'Cabana B09 . Large cabana . Beach, AED 1,855' and starts a remaining-time counter. Prices: Family 6 = 995, Medium 10 = 1,295, Large 15 = 1,855, XL 20 = 2,295.
package: Contradicts audit R073(c): 'Cabanas stay staff-booked and GST-070 becomes table-only' (GST-070 notes). Also contradicts resources.yaml bookResource (~l.230): staff-only since 19 Sep per the 26 Aug minute, 'never a specific room/vehicle/instructor'. The package sells cabanas as a capacity product on GST-050/GST-058 (wave 3, addCartLine + getAvailability), with no web screen. A route exists if the client wants choice: ResourceType.customerSelectable (~l.2485) + setResourceSelectionPolicy mode guestMayChoose (~l.2159) + allocateResources preferredResourceIds (~l.2010). The countdown matches the cart lease (R169, 15 min).
proposal: First release: sell cabanas by size (Family/Medium/Large/XL) as capacity products on GST-050/GST-058, allocated by the platform. If the client wants map picking: a CR reopens R073(c); set guestMayChoose on the cabana ticket types; add a guest read of per-cabana availability with venue-map positions; add AddCartLine attributes.preferredResourceId passed to allocateResources; add a WEB cabana screen.
needsClient: Picking a numbered cabana contradicts the 28 Sep default (R073(c)) and the 26 Aug minute. Should guests choose a specific cabana (reopen R073(c)), or book by cabana size? Also confirm the cabana numbering and prices.
decision: Cabana maps work like the stadium seat map: we ingest the venue's map (cabanas and their numbers, zones, capacity, price bands), and guests pick a specific cabana on the map and buy it. Supersedes R073(c) for resources on an ingested map.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#16 Category then subcategory, configurable in the CMS
what: Category tiles (Permanent exhibition, Temporary exhibitions, Guided tours, Courses) then that category's tickets, each with Adult/Child/Student counters. Config: Ticket categories = Category->subcategory or Flat list.
package: ProductCategory is a tree (parentId, displayOrder, imageAssetId; catalogue.yaml ~l.10483), and Product.categoryId exists. listProducts filters only venueId and kind (no categoryId), and BookingFlowConfig has no display field.
proposal: Add a categoryId query param to listProducts (guest). Add BookingFlowConfig.ticketCategories enum [categoryThenSubcategory, flatList] default categoryThenSubcategory.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add a categoryId query param to listProducts (guest). Add BookingFlowConfig.ticketCategories enum [categoryThenSubcategory, flatList] default categoryThenSubcategory.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#17 Guided tour times by tour language (also #7 cinema 'language & format')
what: Pick a language (EN, AR, FR, DE, ZH, RU) and only tours in that language are listed. Cinema shows pick language and format.
package: Performance (catalogue.yaml ~l.12039) has no language or format field, and listPerformances filters only from/to. Not found in sources/ as a stated requirement (only 'Guided Tour' as a product/package item).
proposal: Add Performance.language (BCP 47, nullable) and Performance.format (string, nullable, e.g. 2D/3D/subtitled). Add a language query param to listPerformances.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add Performance.language (BCP 47, nullable) and Performance.format (string, nullable, e.g. 2D/3D/subtitled). Add a language query param to listPerformances.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#18 One tenant, attraction in several locations; change location on the booking screen
what: The guest picks a location first; a 'Booking at' bar on the booking screen has Change location; selections are kept and times and prices refresh. Config: Location switcher (on/off).
package: R267 is applied: a venue picker on WEB-001 (P01 ~l.243-442), remembered and changeable, fed by the public venue list (white-label.yaml ~l.512). Missing: a switcher on the booking screens. 'Selections kept' has no key: products are per venue (Product.venueId), and codes are unique per tenant (R108), so the same ticket at two venues shares no identifier.
proposal: Add a 'Booking at' venue switcher to WEB-005/WEB-006/GST-007/GST-008 that reuses the R267 venue choice. On a switch, clear the selection unless products share a new optional Product.familyKey (tenant-unique family, per-venue product). Add BookingFlowConfig.locationSwitcher bool.
needsClient: Must selections carry across locations (which needs a product family key), or is restarting the selection acceptable?
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add a 'Booking at' venue switcher to WEB-005/WEB-006/GST-007/GST-008 that reuses the R267 venue choice. On a switch, clear the selection unless products share a new optional Product.familyKey (tenant-unique family, per-venue product). Add BookingFlowConfig.locationSwitcher bool.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#19 Surf sessions with filters (as on The Wave); 28 Sep four-day calendar with option descriptions
what: Dropdowns Choose your experience (surf, lessons, swim, sauna) and Select surf level (beginner-expert), each option with a short description, plus Reset, day-part chips and paging. A 4-day calendar shows performances by time with places left and price per surfer; sold-out greyed.
package: Experience maps to ProductCategory/Product. There is no 'level' attribute: Product.segmentTags is free text and Performance has no attributes. Places left per performance needs a batched getAvailability (see REV3-1). listProducts has no category or tag filter.
proposal: Model level as Product.segmentTags 'level/<code>' (or a VariantDimension). Add categoryId and segmentTag filters to listProducts. Take option descriptions from ProductCategory (add description LocalisedText). Reuse the getAvailability eventId+date-range change from REV3-1. The 4-day calendar layout needs no package change.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Model level as Product.segmentTags 'level/<code>' (or a VariantDimension). Add categoryId and segmentTag filters to listProducts. Take option descriptions from ProductCategory (add description LocalisedText). Reuse the getAvailability eventId+date-range change from REV3-1. The 4-day calendar layout needs no package change.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#20 Enable or disable a Quick Tour of the customer journey
what: A 4-step first-visit coach-mark tour (date, time, tickets, basket) with Back/Next/End, replayable from a Quick tour button. Config: Quick tour (on/off).
package: No field. Not in sources/.
proposal: Add BookingFlowConfig.quickTour bool default false. The first-visit flag is kept on the device only.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add BookingFlowConfig.quickTour bool default false. The first-visit flag is kept on the device only.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#21 Transport tickets (Emirates Link); 28 Sep RTA layout; EMAIL-TO-CLIENT.md ask 1
what: Intercity coach: From/To stations with swap, date, time period with departure counts, departure cards (arrival, duration, seats left, fare), passenger types (adult; child and student half fare; person of determination free). Multi-trip 5/10-trip carnets and weekly/monthly unlimited; favourite routes; route stop list and a street map (needs internet); Search Trips and Next Available Trip.
package: The contracts have no station, route, timetable, trip, fare-table or favourite-route entity (grep transport/station/route/trip finds none). The closest pieces: Event+Performance could model a departure; ProductKind openDated with entitlement entries_allowed could model carnets and unlimited passes; ResourceKind 'vehicle'. Sources: 'Transportation' appears only as a component of a group package (workshop pack Group Sales 9.1.4/9.1.5), never as scheduled public-transport ticketing, so it looks out of RFP scope. The street map adds a third-party tile provider, which needs approval under R038.
proposal: Do not add it to the package until the client confirms scope with a CR. If accepted: a TransportService (or a catalogue extension) with Station, Route (ordered stops), Departure (a Performance per leg), a fare matrix by passenger type, carnet and period passes as openDated products, and guest favourite routes. Add a map-tile dependency to the R038 list. New WEB/GST screens.
decision: Transport ticketing is in scope: stations, routes, timetabled departures, one-way, multi-trip passes, favourites, route map. The network (stations, routes, fares, passenger types, pass types, timetables) is configured by the venue in Venue Management setup screens, with a bulk import, like every other module; it is not an open value from the client. The prototype's E101 sample values are seed data for the demo tenant. (Confirmed 29 September.)

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#Built to match your examples: Swim question (water park)
what: A themed pop-up 'Are you able to swim?' (Yes/No, Next) appears once after the session/date on any water-park flow; 'Yes' clears the swimmer check for the whole booking. Config: Swim consent pop-up (on/off).
package: The package declares swim ability per person: ProductEligibilityRule.swimAbility [notRequired, confident] and EligibilityDeclaration.confidentSwimmer per party member (catalogue.yaml ~l.11420, ~l.11470), checked by checkBookingEligibility. One booking-level yes that clears everyone contradicts that per-person contract shape. A tenant toggle is redundant with the per-product rule.
proposal: Keep the pop-up UI but record the answer per declared person (one 'everyone in my party can swim' tick that sets confidentSwimmer for each person is fine). Show it when any cart product has swimAbility=confident, not from a tenant toggle.
needsClient: Can one person declare swim ability for the whole party, or must each guest (or guardian) confirm per person?
decision: The swim question is a consent, not a data field: a venue attaches one or several consent questions to a product or flow (e.g. 'Are you able to swim?', 'Do you hold a scuba certification?', 'I accept the risk'), each with its own text, version and whether it is per person or once per booking. The answer is stored as a consent record (question version, answer, who answered, when). Single or multiple questions, per the venue's choice.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-FEEDBACK-23SEP.md#3 Read more carries per-ticket-type tags; BUILD-YOUR-EXPERIENCE.md#Ticket tags
what: Tags such as '2 Hours', 'Min 1.10 m', 'Free adult entry', 'Valid 90 days', 'Emirates ID'. They come from the ticket's own tags list of {type: clock|height|free|cal|id, label}, else are derived from duration, validity and the height rule. Config: Tags on tickets (on/off).
package: Product/ProductVariant have no display-tag field (Product.segmentTags is for reporting and segmentation). The derivation sources exist: ProductEligibilityRule.minHeightCm and entitlement validity.
proposal: Add Product.displayTags[] {kind enum [clock, height, free, calendar, id], label: LocalisedText}, max 6. The derivation fallback happens on read. Add BookingFlowConfig.ticketTags bool default true.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add Product.displayTags[] {kind enum [clock, height, free, calendar, id], label: LocalisedText}, max 6. The derivation fallback happens on read. Add BookingFlowConfig.ticketTags bool default true.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-FEEDBACK-23SEP.md#4 Video or image should show (each ticket has its own photo)
what: Read more opens with the ticket's video or photo, and each ticket in a listing has its own photo.
package: Product has no media field; only ProductCategory.imageAssetId exists (catalogue.yaml ~l.10550). The asset library (assets.yaml) tracks usage but nothing links an asset to a product.
proposal: Add Product.media[] {assetId, kind [image, video], isPrimary} referencing assets.yaml assets, and register the reference in asset usage.
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add Product.media[] {assetId, kind [image, video], isPrimary} referencing assets.yaml assets, and register the reference in asset usage.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-FEEDBACK-23SEP.md#5 Clicking a Dated Day Pass shows counters on the same screen (no extra Select Tickets step)
what: Counters open in a side panel on the listing/details screen; Book goes straight into the booking.
package: The package has separate WEB-004 Attraction Details -> WEB-005 Ticket Type Selection screens.
proposal: Allow WEB-005 to render as a side panel on WEB-002/WEB-004 (a navigation change; no contract change).
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Allow WEB-005 to render as a side panel on WEB-002/WEB-004 (a navigation change; no contract change).

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-FEEDBACK-23SEP.md#6 Extra information (i) for each Adult/Child/Senior/Infant row
what: Each ticket-type row explains who it is for and what it includes. Config: Extra info on cards (cardInfo).
package: ProductVariant (catalogue.yaml ~l.11794) has sku, axisValues, name, barcode, isDefault and isActive, with no description. BookingFlowConfig has no cardInfo.
proposal: Add ProductVariant.description (LocalisedText, <=300 chars). Add BookingFlowConfig.cardInfo bool default true.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-FEEDBACK-23SEP.md#14 View to the stage from the selected section

source: DESIGN-GAP-RESPONSE-23SEP.md#6 Booking-flow configuration (CMS-016): card layout options; TICVAI Engine Controls Manual.dc.html + Guest Booking v2.dc.html twSpec() Card layout/Card size/Density
what: The design says card layout need not be free text: Stacked rows, Split rows, Cards across, Poster cards. Card size: Compact, Standard, Large, Extra large (default Compact). Density: Compact, Standard, Roomy (default Compact).
package: BookingFlowConfig.cardLayout is a free string (maxLength 40, nullable). cardSize enum is [compact, regular, large] with no extra large. density enum is [compact, comfortable, airy] with default comfortable, where the design default is Compact.
proposal: cardLayout becomes enum [stackedRows, splitRows, cardsAcross, posterCards] default stackedRows. cardSize becomes [compact, standard, large, extraLarge] default compact. density becomes [compact, standard, roomy] default compact (or keep the names and document the label mapping).
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): cardLayout becomes enum [stackedRows, splitRows, cardsAcross, posterCards] default stackedRows. cardSize becomes [compact, standard, large, extraLarge] default compact. density becomes [compact, standard, roomy] default compact (or keep the names and document the label mapping).

source: CLAUDE-CODE-GAP-FIX.md#B Login: set up two-step verification; #C Security & Sign-in (step-up auth)
what: The prompt asks the prototype to add guest 2FA setup on web and step-up auth on mobile Security & Sign-in.
package: Contradicts audit R167 ('No SSO for guests and no guest MFA at sign-in') and R073(a). The GST-073 notes say createMfaChallenge was removed and a guest cannot enrol a method.
proposal: Drop 2FA setup and step-up from the prototype. Guests keep OTP, social and UAE Pass sign-in.
decision: Guest two-step verification is a per-venue setting (VenueSettings), off by default. A guest's enrolment is on their tenant-wide account; the second factor is asked only when signing in or acting at a venue that enables it. Supersedes R167 part 2; guests still never use enterprise SSO. (Per venue confirmed 29 September.)

proposal: Show status, maintenance and contact only. If a guest-facing 'what's new' is wanted, add a separate public releaseNotes (LocalisedText) field.
decision: Show guests recent changes: add a public, localised 'what's new' (release notes) the guest Help screen reads.

source: CLAUDE-CODE-GAP-FIX.md#C Wave 2: Reserve a Table or Cabana (waitlist, notify)
what: The prompt keeps the combined table-or-cabana screen.

proposal: Build GST-070 as table-only with leave-waitlist. Cabanas follow REV3-15.
decision: The table/cabana screen becomes a map-based booking: a venue map can carry cabanas, loungers, tables and other bookable resources (same ingestion as REV3-15). Tables on a venue map are non-dining spots (beach or event tables) sold like cabanas; dining tables stay F&B table reservations (confirmed 29 September).

package: The package has GST-051/052/053/054/059 in wave 4, and R209 makes the itinerary suggestion conditional on the planner shipping (R187).
proposal: Align the prototype to wave 4, and show the itinerary suggestion only if the planner ships.
decision: Itinerary screens stay in wave 4.

source: CLAUDE-CODE-GAP-FIX.md#D Mobile-only features get web equivalents: Face Pass and Security & Sign-in on web Account
what: Adds Face Pass (register/status/withdraw) and security (devices, trust device, sign out a lost device, recovery) to the web account.
package: P01 has no Face Pass or security screen: the functions live on GST-069/GST-073, and WEB-024 covers devices and consent. Face capture depends on the client's facial-reader vendor SDK (R077(b), still open), which may not run in a browser.
proposal: Add the device and sign-out-lost-device functions to WEB-024. Keep Face Pass mobile-only until the vendor SDK is named and supports web capture.
needsClient: Do you want Face Pass enrolment on the web? That depends on your facial-reader vendor (R077(b)).
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Add the device and sign-out-lost-device functions to WEB-024. Keep Face Pass mobile-only until the vendor SDK is named and supports web capture.

source: CLAUDE-CODE-GAP-FIX.md#D Wave mismatches (Parking, Virtual Queue, Multi-Currency) - build on both now
what: The prompt builds these on web and mobile regardless of wave.
package: Package waves differ between shells: WEB-041 wave 2 vs GST-027/028 wave 3; WEB-040 wave 2 vs GST-023 wave 3; WEB-035 wave 1 vs GST-044 wave 2. Parking scope is set by R166 (cart-sold, no live availability).
proposal: Align each pair to one wave in P01/P02 once the client picks it.
needsClient: Which wave should parking, virtual queue and multi-currency ship in on both web and mobile?
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Align each pair to one wave in P01/P02 once the client picks it.

source: CLAUDE-CODE-GAP-FIX.md#D Duplicate screens merged (mobile Transfer + Delivery & Sharing + Tickets & Add-ons; web Wishlist + Devices/Consent; Help Centre + Help & Accessibility); group booking on web

package: P02 keeps GST-014, GST-045 and GST-008 separate (GST-008's only api is transferOrderTickets, which supports the duplicate reading). P01 keeps WEB-009/WEB-024 and WEB-025/WEB-045. Group booking on web is already WEB-031 (requestGroupBooking); GST-072 on mobile.
proposal: Record each merge as one implementation with several screen IDs; keep the IDs. Move the ticket-selection functions GST-008's name promises onto GST-008.
needsClient: Confirm the screen merges (the plan counts 46 web and 71 mobile screens).
decision: Our proposal adopted (29 September): Record each merge as one implementation with several screen IDs; keep the IDs. Move the ticket-selection functions GST-008's name promises onto GST-008.

source: EMAIL-TO-CLIENT.md 'Sessions can be added, edited or closed from Config -> Sessions'; guest copy 'Surf sessions', 'Timed access 10-minute slots'
what: A drawer editor to add, edit or close sessions per flow, and 'session' used in guest-facing copy.
package: The function exists as Performance management (createPerformances, Performance.status suspended/cancelled; BO-015). Audit R165 renamed Session to Performance, and the glossary bans 'Session'. R145 made a recorded exception only for 'Booking'.

source: CLIENT-RESPONSE-REV3-25SEP.md#Where the settings live: all Rev 3 options 'set per tenant' as engine properties
what: Every Rev 3 option sits in Config -> Booking rules (Rev 3) and is exposed as a per-tenant property.
package: BookingFlowConfig is tenant-scoped (x-ticvai-config-scope: tenant) and embedded in tenant_config, so one tenant with several venues (Kids Club x4, Coastal Aqua vs Union Arena) cannot differ per venue.
proposal: Put the Rev 3 fields (REV3-1..20, 23SEP-3/6/18/19) in BookingFlowConfig with an optional venue override map, venueOverrides{venueId: partial BookingFlowConfig}, following the VenueSettings tenant-default pattern.
needsClient: Do any booking-flow settings need to differ between venues of one tenant?
decision: Booking-flow settings are set per tenant with a per-venue override (venueOverrides). Adopted 29 September.
